purpose: Do not invent failure in the original free ride; bind the new short challenge as an explicit mobile hypothesis.

observed: SOURCE_CODE: fish capture requires spatial proximity; missed fish despawn without an existing loss terminal.
SOURCE_CODE: optional autopilot targets the next fish after no manual steering.
inferred: A visible timed target may give a quick replay loop, but player appeal is not proven.
evidence.applicabilityRationale: Retain existing riding/rendering in a private prototype; add only a short, owned challenge wrapper.
rejectExpression: No commercial distribution of original models, audio, UI or source without rights clearance.

rules.trigger: A visible fish passes the mouth without meeting spatial proximity.
rules.playerSignal: Glowing fish position and source score pop; missed fish adds no points.
rules.escalation: Original free ride has no increasing failure requirement. The new ninety-second score target is a separate hypothesis.
rules.failureOutcome: Original: no game over. Private challenge: timer ends and low score is visibly explained.
rules.attribution: Aim/steer toward the visible fish before it passes; no hidden random death rule.
rules.recovery: Normal restart; best score/supplies persist. Pause freezes the private challenge and original ride.
implementationImplications: Use existing manual steering plus the small mobile challenge adapter.

noCopyBoundary: User-directed private source work only. Public reusable modules contain only our own touch/lifecycle/ad glue; no upstream game code or visuals.
